card.statement:
Recall from Remark 3.1(2) that, in case $G=\mathrm{GL}_{2}$ , the stack $\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{B}$ is smooth. Using (the Grothendieck–Verdier dual of) Lemma 3.3, it follows that in this case we have $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{U}}\cong\omega_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{U}}[-(g-1)\dim(U)]$ , hence by Theorem 5.9 we have $\mathrm{Ga}^{\frac{\infty}{2}}\cong\omega_{\overline{\mathrm{S}_{0,c}}}$ .

In case $\Bbbk$ has characteristic $0$ , this statement is [17, Theorem 3.2.2], and our proof (given in §5.6 below) will follow the same strategy as in [17].

5.4. Applications

Before giving the proof of Theorem 5.9, we explain our main application of this result.
card.label: Remark 5.10

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
